It’s that more and more people are starting to put Uniswap to work.

I took a close look at yesterday’s news about OKX and ICE.
They plan to offer tokenized U.S. stock trading on X Layer, using Uniswap v4 directly for the underlying liquidity pools, with Hooks to implement whitelisting and compliance restrictions. The plan covers more than 60 U.S. stocks and is still in progress.

That’s really interesting.

But what’s really worth paying attention to now is who provides the trading and liquidity infrastructure.
And you’ll find that Uniswap v4 keeps showing up in that role.
It’s being used by Robinhood Chain, studied for Japan’s financial institutions’ DeFi Gateway, and now it’s also part of the plans from OKX and ICE.

This is no longer just one project telling a story.
More and more different chains and institutions are trying to make Uniswap v4 their underlying trading infrastructure.
That’s why I’m still bullish on $UNI .

Because if on-chain stocks, bonds, funds, and other assets really do become more widespread in the future, the most valuable thing won’t be which stock token goes up.
It’ll be whoever becomes the liquidity infrastructure behind these assets.
If this trend continues, UNI won’t just benefit from a single market rally—it’ll capture the growth in trading activity across an entirely new market.

Of course, don’t take this to mean that tokenized stocks = UNI is guaranteed to go up. The projects are still in progress.
But honestly:

Because what really makes the market FOMO has never been someone saying UNI is great.
It’s the day everyone suddenly realizes: “Damn, all these new assets are starting to use Uniswap.”

我最近越来越觉得，$UNI 现在真正有意思的地方，可能不是又出了一个什么利好。
而是越来越多的人开始拿Uniswap来做事情了。

昨天OKX和ICE的这个消息，我认真看了一下。
他们计划在X Layer上做代币化美股交易，而且底层流动性池直接用 Uniswap v4，通过Hook来实现白名单和合规限制。计划覆盖60多只美股，目前还在推进阶段。

这就很有意思了。
以前我们说股票代币化，很多人第一反应就是：又一个RWA项目。
但现在真正值得看的，是谁来提供交易和流动性基础设施。
结果你会发现，Uniswap v4一次又一次出现在这个位置。
Robinhood Chain有它，日本金融机构的DeFi Gateway在研究它，现在OKX和ICE的方案也准备用它。

这就不是单纯一个项目在讲故事了。
而是越来越多不同链、不同机构，都在尝试把Uniswap v4当成自己的交易底层。
这才是我现在继续看好$UNI 的原因。

因为如果未来链上股票、债券、基金这些东西真的越来越多，最值钱的不是哪只股票代币涨了。
而是谁成为这些资产背后的流动性基础设施。
如果这个方向继续跑下去，UNI吃到的不是一次行情，而是一整个新市场的交易增量。

当然，别理解成股票代币化=UNI必涨，项目也还在推进中。
但说实话：
一个接一个传统金融玩家开始把Uniswap v4放进自己的方案里，这个信号我很难忽略。

现在$UNI 还在9刀附近磨。
大家觉得无聊的时候，反而更应该重视。
因为真正让市场FOMO的，从来不是有人说UNI好。
而是某一天大家突然发现：卧槽，原来这么多新资产都开始用Uniswap了。
到那时候再追，和现在看，完全就是两个心态了。
